description.text: Main Courses are: Topics on China system reform; Trade organization and China; International commercial law; China's foreign trade & international policy; Economic news reading; Business writing; Commercial law on foreign trade; Business Chinese Application Deadline Autumn Semester: Before Jun 10

duration.text: The Economics Program Courses at Capital University of Economics and Business is a 6 Months long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/In total ￥ 21000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of employment or education Students still at school should provide school attendance certificate, graduates who have a job should provide working certificate. Certificate should be written in English and Chinese.
